name: Haus Mühlanger
beschreibung: The Haus Mühlanger is quietly positioned in a sunny spot on the outskirts of Serfaus on Tyrol's famous sunny plateau. The generously proportioned guest rooms are decorated in an authentic Tyrolean alpine style with solid natural timber, featuring en-suite bathrooms with shower/WC and private balconies with expansive mountain views. In the morning, a tasty breakfast buffet featuring regional specialities is served in the bright breakfast room. Thanks to the peaceful location and quick access to the village's unique Dorfbahn underground railway, guests can reach the main cable car stations effortlessly without a car. In summer, family theme paths and single trails entice active visitors, while winter brings premier skiing across the Serfaus-Fiss-Ladis expanses.
kurzbeschreibung: Cosy guesthouse in a sunny edge-of-village location in Serfaus on Tyrol's sunny plateau with spacious rooms and alpine views.
